jacks.label: OUTPUT

jacks.label: 9V DC
jacks.note: 9V DC center-negative, 2.1 x 5.5 mm; top edge; no battery operation. Position assumed centered.

power.note: 9V DC negative center; 12 mA; no battery operation.

io.note: One 1/4-inch TS mono input (right side) and one 1/4-inch TS mono output (left side).

audio.note: Mono in/out; no effects loop, headphones or DI.

control.note: Volume, Tone and Drive knobs plus a +/- clipping toggle; LED shows effect on.

circuit.note: Tube Screamer-style analog circuit with the JHS Strong Mod; true bypass.

physical.note: 112 x 60 x 31 mm (L x W x H); 210 g; metal housing.

optional.note: Optional facts captured during the same official page/manual/retailer pass.

notes: JHS 3 Series Screamer — Tube Screamer-style overdrive with the JHS Strong Mod; Volume, Tone and Drive controls plus a +/- clipping toggle; true bypass; 9V DC, 12 mA.

extra.toggle: +/- clipping: up = asymmetrical (JHS Strong Mod), down = symmetrical (TS9/TS808 style)
extra.circuit: Analog Tube Screamer-style with JHS Strong Mod
extra.jackPositions: Official manual: INPUT on the right side, OUTPUT on the left side, POWER on the top edge. Positions estimated from the official top-down image (I/O ~0.70 along the side, 0=back/1=front) and the power assumed centered (~0.5); normalized estimates, not measured cm.
extra.imageProcessing: Official JHS Front top-down has transparent padding and protruding side jack barrels. Cropped to the enclosure body (1024x1904 px; aspect 0.540 vs the 6.05x11.23 cm footprint) so the jacks do not inflate the width; hosted as AVIF q80. PSNR 44.4 dB vs the PNG cutout; vision-accepted at 1:1 and 2x.
